title: Components of $V(mρ) \otimes V(nρ)$
summary: Let $\mathfrak{g}$ be a symmetrizable Kac-Moody Lie algebra and let $ρ$ denote the sum of the fundamental weights. The irreducible highest weight representations $V(mρ)$ occupy a distinguished position in representation theory due to their rich symmetry and geometric significance. In this paper, we study the tensor products \[ V(mρ)\otimes V(nρ), \quad m,n \in \mathbb{N}, \] and investigate the structure of their irreducible decompositions.
